accountability.justification: The candidate directly states the three-day outage with Eastern Time dates, explicitly takes responsibility for the checkout update, avoids blaming a supplier, does not speculate about security, and acknowledges it cannot promise the site will never fail again. The revised sentence adds specific process changes rather than an evasive promise, strengthening accountability.
quotes: Our website was down from Friday at 9 a.m. Eastern through Monday at 9 a.m. Eastern, right in the middle of our sale.
The outage was caused by a checkout update on our end. We’re not blaming a supplier or outside service—this one is on us.

We can’t promise the site will never fail again, but we are changing our process for checkout updates: adding more pre-launch testing and rolling out changes in smaller stages so a failure like this is less likely.
accountability.improvement: Ensure the revised sentence is inserted into the final published post, replacing the earlier vague promise to 'keep working on it' so the final version does not retain the evasive phrasing.

offer_clarity.justification: The candidate accurately communicates the restored automatic 20% discount, the fresh 72-hour window with explicit Eastern Time start and end, no code needed, merchandise-only application, shipping and gift-card exclusions, no stacking, and explicitly states no extra credits or free shipping, without inventing additional compensation.
quotes: we’ve restored the original 20% sitewide discount automatically. It is active now and will run for a fresh 72 hours, from Monday at 9 a.m. Eastern through Thursday at 9 a.m. Eastern. No code is needed.
The discount applies to merchandise only, excludes shipping and gift cards, and cannot be combined with other discounts. We are not offering extra credits or free shipping as part of this response.

trust_and_tone.justification: The candidate uses a plain, restrained, human voice, directs payment concerns to private support through the Contact page, and carefully distinguishes pending authorizations from confirmed charges while avoiding any refund promise. The revision replaces vague language with a concrete process change, improving credibility.
quotes: If you have a pending card authorization but did not receive an order confirmation, please reach out privately through the Contact page on our website.

overall_impression: The candidate produced a clear, accurate, and accountable public apology that meets the scenario requirements. The offer details are exact, the tone is appropriate, and the revision addresses the vague language with specific preventive actions. The final response is strong, with minor integration concerns only.
